scope: Public operator sources for webcams in the municipality of Rio de Janeiro, beyond additional YouTube streams
method: Public website inspection, HTTP framing/redirect checks, Chrome headless page/video inspection. No login, private API, credential extraction, proxying or bypass used. A 200 response and an advertisement playing are not camera playback confirmation.
summary: No new non-YouTube source qualified for immediate reliable inline playback in this bounded review. Two new operator references could be considered as external links; existing sources have substantive embedding or availability limitations.

candidates.name: Pestana Atlantica / Copacabana — earthTV
candidates.coordinateEvidence: Public page structured data explicitly publishes latitude -22.9751 and longitude -43.1877; text locates camera atop Pestana Atlantica Hotel. Treat as operator reference, not independently surveyed installation.
observations: Page currently labels the item TIME TRAVEL, not a guaranteed current live feed.
Public Play Video button loaded a 1280-pixel advertisement advancing to 8.107313 seconds; advertisement playback does not validate the camera.
Player configuration includes a signed embed URL; no token stored or proposed for catalog use.
candidates.recommendation: External reference only unless operator supplies stable supported embed and current camera playback is validated. Do not market historical/time-travel video as live.

candidates.name: Praia Barra da Tijuca — PraiaBarra
candidates.coordinateEvidence: Page names Barra da Tijuca beach, but weather map center does not establish camera installation; no coordinates proposed.
observations: Public page embeds a JMVStream HTTPS player.
Operator explicitly states streaming access is exclusive through praiabarra.com.br and restricts reproduction of site content.
Passive Chrome inspection did not expose a playing camera video.
candidates.recommendation: External reference only. Obtain operator authorization and a supported embed before inline integration; do not reuse the iframe merely because it exists.

candidates.name: Instituto Mar Urbano — Copacabana Posto 6
candidates.coordinateEvidence: Official page identifies Copacabana Posto 6 but does not identify measured installation coordinates.
observations: Public HTML at /live-cam/ contains video#videojs_player but no media source was attached after page load.

New menu route https://institutomarurbano.com.br/live-cam-imu/ also inspected in Chrome: media blob source attached, but playback failed with MEDIA_ERR_SRC_NOT_SUPPORTED code 4, readyState 0, videoWidth 0, currentTime 0; player reports server/network failure or unsupported format. No functional inline media confirmed.
candidates.recommendation: Keep external with unavailability qualification; no legitimate functioning inline URL discovered.

candidates.name: SurfConnect — Leme and Leme Fixa
candidates.coordinateEvidence: Existing catalog has operator beach-reference coordinates; no more precise position established in this review.
observations: Legacy HTTPS Leme and Leme Fixa pages redirect to HTTP.
Legacy public Leme camera iframe HTTPS /spot/camera/id/8/ also redirects to HTTP; embedding on HTTPS would encounter mixed-content restrictions.
Current commercial site advertises five rotating free cameras and premium access; this does not establish a stable unauthenticated third-party embed.
candidates.recommendation: Keep external operator flow. Do not downgrade security or bypass registration/subscription. Ask operator for HTTPS public embed partnership if desired.

candidates.name: Paineiras Corcovado — official operator
candidates.coordinateEvidence: Official operator article identifies Centro de Visitantes Paineiras; no measured camera coordinate found. Do not use monument coordinates as camera position.
observations: Operator group article from 2020 contains historical YouTube embeds omhwVDDIS54 and Ba9v-GN5cyc.
Current official website links the YouTube channel UCAThQaz8B3AWOQwA8j-Arnw; no independent non-YouTube camera player found.
candidates.recommendation: Use current official YouTube stream only after independent playback validation; do not add old article embeds or claim they are additional cameras.

candidates.name: SkylineWebcams — Copacabana promenade
candidates.operator: SkylineWebcams directory / Homes in Rio stream
observations: Page structured data points to YouTube k2QzfrPLQSg, already identified as Homes in Rio Posto 3.
The directory page itself blocks cross-origin framing.
candidates.recommendation: Do not add as another camera. Keep existing operator-linked YouTube record.
